result.summary: This PR renames and rewrites the wallet_reindex.py functional test to wallet_birthtime.py, removing a node restart step that the author argues is unnecessary since rescanblockchain already exercises the wallet birthtime update being tested. It also trims the number of blocks generated, switches to the common bumpmocktime helper, unloads an unneeded wallet before block generation, and adds clarifying comments. The stated payoff is reducing the test's runtime from about 2 seconds to 0 seconds in CI.
result.problem: The original wallet_reindex.py test restarted the node (misleadingly implying a -reindex was exercised) purely to verify that birthtime and confirmations survive a restart, when the property under test (birthtime update via rescanblockchain) does not require a restart at all. This wastes CI time and obscures test intent for anyone reading or maintaining wallet tests.
